nodes.description: Private admin address state variable of RootChainlink, used as the authorization check in the onlyAdmin modifier.
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the proxy implementation address (EIP-1967 style).
Constructor of RootChainlink that initializes the admin account via _setAdmin.
External onlyAdmin function that upgrades the proxy to a new implementation by calling upgradeTo.
External onlyAdmin function that changes the admin account via _setAdmin.
Internal function that writes the admin address into the _admin state variable.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the stored _admin address.
Virtual public initializer of the proxy, delegatecalled on the new implementation during upgrade.
Public view returning the current implementation address read from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via assembly sload.
Internal upgrade routine: stores the new implementation then delegatecalls initialize() on it.
Internal function validating the new implementation is a contract then sstoring it into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Payable receive function emitting ValueReceived with the caller and value.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls the stored implementation with raw calldata.
Library function returning true when extcodesize(account) > 0.
Caller-controlled address used for admin authorization and event emission.
Low-level delegatecall in upgradeTo invoking initialize() on the newly set implementation.
Low-level delegatecall in fallback forwarding arbitrary calldata to the implementation.
Assembly sstore writing the implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Assembly sload reading the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Constructor argument admin of RootChainlink.
Implementation address argument of RootChainlink.implement.
New admin address argument of RootChainlink.setAdmin.
Admin address argument of RootChainlink._setAdmin.
New implementation address argument of BaseUpgradeabililtyProxy.upgradeTo.
New implementation address argument of BaseUpgradeabililtyProxy.setImplementation.
Account address argument of UpgradesAddress.isContract.
Local bytes32 slot variable in implementation() set to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Local address impl variable in implementation() populated from sload.
Local address _impl variable in fallback() holding the resolved implementation.
Local bool success flag returned by the delegatecall in upgradeTo.
Local uint256 size holding the extcodesize result in UpgradesAddress.isContract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the stored admin inside the onlyAdmin modifier.
_admin state variable is read by the onlyAdmin authorization check.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of the privileged implement function.
onlyAdmin modifier gates execution of the privileged setAdmin function.
implement calls upgradeTo to perform the proxy upgrade.
implementation parameter is forwarded to upgradeTo as the new implementation.
upgradeTo calls setImplementation to persist the new implementation address.
newImplementation argument of upgradeTo is passed into setImplementation.
newImplementation is the delegatecall target in the initialize call.
newImplementation value is the data written by the sstore into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
setImplementation argument is stored into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via assembly.
upgradeTo performs an external delegatecall on a freshly-set implementation before state is finalized.
The delegatecall target can re-enter the proxy fallback and execute arbitrary logic.
The delegatecall target can re-enter upgradeTo and repeat the upgrade sequence.
setAdmin delegates the privileged write to the internal _setAdmin function.
setAdmin argument admin is forwarded to the _setAdmin parameter.
_setAdmin argument is unconditionally assigned to the privileged _admin state variable.
Constructor calls _setAdmin to initialize the admin account.
Constructor argument admin is forwarded into _setAdmin.
_setAdmin writes the caller-supplied admin address into _admin.
implementation() executes the assembly sload to read the stored implementation.
sload reads the value stored at IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
setImplementation executes the assembly sstore after the contract check.
sstore writes the implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
setImplementation calls UpgradesAddress.isContract to validate the new implementation.
account parameter is the address whose code size is checked by isContract.
fallback executes a delegatecall with raw attacker-controlled calldata.
The delegatecall target can re-enter the fallback, enabling recursive external calls.
fallback calls implementation() to resolve the delegatecall target.
msg.sender is emitted in the ValueReceived event of the receive function.
Reentrant delegatecall into the implementation may invoke the upgrade path again.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter admin is only used to initialize the contract and should be folded into the constructor core function.
implement implementation parameter flows directly to the upgradeTo core function and can be merged into it.
setAdmin admin parameter is consumed directly by the setAdmin core function.
_setAdmin admin parameter is only used by the _setAdmin core function to write _admin.
upgradeTo newImplementation parameter is the core argument of the upgrade routine and should be folded into it.
setImplementation newImplementation parameter is used only by the setImplementation core function.
isContract account parameter is the sole argument of the isContract library core function.
Local slot variable only holds IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT inside the implementation core function.
Local impl variable only receives the sload result inside implementation().
Local _impl variable only stores the resolved implementation inside the fallback core function.
Local success flag only reflects the delegatecall outcome of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Local size variable only holds the extcodesize result inside isContract().
